# Key bindings

Every row with an **Action** is rebindable in `keys.toml`; fixed inputs such as `Ctrl-c`, digits, search editing, and mouse gestures are not. Use the Action value as the key; run `snip keys path` to find the file, `snip keys show <action>` to inspect one, and `snip keys check` to validate your edits.

Bindings are grouped by *mode* — the context a key is live in. Normal pane stacks include `global`, while exclusive modes expose only the global actions in their inheritance allowlist. When several modes are active, the narrower one wins.

## global

Part of normal pane stacks; exclusive modes inherit only commands in their allowlist.

| Key | Action | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | `library.search` | Search the snippet library |
| `:` / `Ctrl-p` | `palette.open` | Open the command palette |
| `?` | `view.toggle-help` | Open or close the help panel |
| `A` | `view.cycle-appearance` | Switch between light and dark appearance |
| `N` | `view.toggle-line-numbers` | Show or hide preview line numbers |
| `S` | `view.toggle-sidebar` | Show or hide the library pane |
| `T` | `library.toggle-trash` | Open or close the trash |
| `Y` | `copy.snippet-id` | Copy the selected snippet ID |
| `[` | `preview.previous-item` | Select the previous preview item |
| `]` | `preview.next-item` | Select the next preview item |
| `h` / `Left` | `pane.back` | Go back to the previous pane |
| `l` / `Right` | `pane.forward` | Drill into the next pane |
| `p` | `copy.managed-path` | Copy the selected managed file path |
| `q` | `app.quit` | Quit snip |
| `s` | `view.cycle-sort` | Cycle the snippet sort order |
| `y` | `copy.content` | Copy the selected fragment content |
| `z` | `view.toggle-density` | Toggle compact snippet list spacing |
| `{` | `preview.previous-paragraph` | Jump to the previous paragraph |
| `}` | `preview.next-paragraph` | Jump to the next paragraph |
| `Shift-Tab` | `pane.previous` | Focus the previous pane |
| `Esc` | `ui.dismiss` | Close the active panel or clear the active filter |
| `F5` / `Ctrl-r` | `library.rescan` | Rescan the snippet library |
| `Tab` | `pane.next` | Focus the next pane |
| `Ctrl-g` | `git.toggle-console` | Open or close the Git console |
| `Ctrl-s` | `gist.toggle-panel` | Open or close the Gist panel |
| `Ctrl-c` | `app.quit` | Force quit before the active mode handles input |
